assembly-panel.caption: The left panel on the Outliner tab with the Parts section open for the gear train assembly sample, components listed with their degrees-of-freedom badges.

bodies-glass.caption: The Bodies tab with several bodies listed and one body selected after choosing the Glass preset, with its Appearance group visible.

bodies-panel.caption: The Bodies tab for a part with three bodies: a plate, a block and a copy, with the plate hidden and the Copy, Delete, Join, Cut and Intersect buttons above the list.

case-section.caption: A section through a small closed case (16 x 12 x 10 mm, same joint): the tongue of the base sits in the groove of the lid with a thin gap on both sides and above it.

case-two-parts.caption: The two halves of the 80 x 50 x 30 mm case apart: the base with the tongue standing on the rim of its walls, and the lid lifted above it.

catalog-primitives.caption: The Catalog panel on the Primitives tab: the Placement row, then the Add material and Remove material columns of shapes.

check-tab.caption: The Check tab with the FDM 3D printing profile run on a part with two separate solids and a thin fin: issues are grouped under Errors and Warnings and the faces are tinted on the part.

circular-pattern-axis.caption: A plate with a round pocket repeated six times on a bolt circle round the plate centre, and the Circular pattern editor open with Axis set to Z axis and the axis point at X = 40, so the axis does not pass through the origin.

constraints-list-open.caption: A dimensioned bracket sketch with relation glyphs in the view and the Constraints list opened from the status chip.

corner-holes.caption: A rectangular plate seen face-on with the hole sketch open, the Corner holes card at the top right of the canvas, and four hole points placed in the corners.

cut-from.caption: The Extrude editor with Operation set to Cut and a Cut from group listing All bodies the shape reaches and one tick per named body.

display-menu.caption: The Display popover open on a part, showing Style, Appearance swatches, Scene presets and the Show list.

drawing-sheet.caption: The Drawing view for the mounting plate sample: front, top, right and isometric views with dimensions and the title block.

edit-breaks-model.caption: The Extrude editor with the depth reduced to 2 mm: a note says the edit would break the rim fillet that comes later, and the Confirm tick is greyed.

edit-curve-editor.caption: A two-line chain rebuilt as one smooth curve, with the Edit curve editor open showing the Curves list, Rebuild and Control point edits.

expression-field.caption: The Extrude editor with the Depth field holding =thick*2, showing the blue fx badge and the evaluated value under the field.

extrude-editor.caption: A block with a circle sketch on its top face and the Extrude editor open in the left panel, with End condition, Operation and Options sections and the preview in the view.

fasten-hole.caption: The Fasten this hole dialog opened from the right-click menu of a Hole feature in the tree: Bolt, Size, Length, Washer, Nut, Head on the other end and the identical-holes option, with the bolts previewed in the holes of a plate.

feature-tree.caption: The Features tab for a bracket plate: sketch rows tucked under their extrude and hole, a thread nested beneath the hole, a fillet, one failed hole row in red, and the rollback line at the bottom.

fillet-editor.caption: A plate with three edges around its top corner selected and the Fillet editor open showing Variable radius, Radius, Profile and Tangent chain.

first-part-dimensioned.caption: A rectangle sketch on the Front plane with 60 and 40 dimensions and the status chip showing the remaining degrees of freedom.

first-part-finished.caption: The finished plate with a hole and a rounded corner, in the Iso view with the feature tree listing the extrude, hole and fillet.

first-part-start.caption: A new empty part with the Start here card offering three Sketch on plane buttons.

freeform-editor.caption: A wavy surface with one face picked, the Freeform editor open on the left, and the face rebuilt as a net with a control point lifted.

import-skp.caption: A SketchUp file imported as a Reference mesh, with the chair and table test file from the OpenSKP project (MIT): the chair and table in the viewport in their SketchUp colours, the imported mesh listed in the feature tree as chair_and_table (mesh), and the open-surface warning in the status bar.

inspect-drawer.caption: The Inspect tab of the drawer under a part, showing the Mass properties card and the result of measuring the distance between two corners.

interface-overview.caption: The default CadKit window with a small part open: top bar, ribbon, feature tree, viewport with view cube, and status bar.

library-tab.caption: The Catalog panel open on the Libraries tab with the search box, the All, Included and Add-ons chips and a grid of cards.

linear-pattern.caption: A bar with a pocket repeated three times along its length and the Linear pattern editor open showing Count and Spacing.

linear-pattern-direction.caption: A plate with a pocket repeated four times along a 45 degree direction, and the Linear pattern editor open with Direction set to a typed direction vector.

lip-joint-editor.caption: A closed case (80 x 50 x 30 mm, 2 mm walls) split in the middle with the Lip joint editor open in the left panel: Height, Width, Clearance and which half carries the tongue.

loft-editor.caption: Three square sketches on offset planes lofted into a tapered solid, with the Profiles list showing three rows and the Guide curves section below.

mate-editor.caption: The Mates section with a Gear mate being edited: both references picked, the ratio filled in and the Test drive slider visible.

move-rotate-ball.caption: A block selected whole with the move and rotate ball at its centre, shown while dragging an axis end dot, with the Distance readout above the ball.

navigation-viewcube.caption: The view cube in the top right corner with its arrow ring, and the Fit and projection buttons under it, the model in the Iso view.

project-curve-editor.caption: A plate with one face picked and the Project curve editor open, showing Project, Onto faces, Direction, Degree and Fit tolerance.

quick-measure.caption: The bottom-right corner of the view with the quick readout card showing the diameter, radius and circumference of a picked circular edge.

reference-plane.caption: A block with a reference plane drawn 10 mm above its top face and the Plane editor open showing Mode, Offset and Base plane.

repeat-last.caption: The Home ribbon's Edit group with the cursor on Repeat last command, after a fillet was applied.

rib-clevis.caption: A base plate with four corner holes, an upright block topped by a round boss with a bore, and a triangular rib joining the block to the plate, built by the bracket-with-a-rib script.

rib-clevis-section.caption: A section through the bracket seen from above: the cut face of the block and boss with the thin rib joined to it on the left.

rib-editor.caption: An L-shaped bracket with a diagonal rib and the Rib editor open in the left panel: the profile sketch, Thickness, Thickness side, Fillet on the free edge and Draft angle, with the rib previewed in the view.

ribbon-tabs.caption: The ribbon with the Home tab selected and the Extrude button flyout open, showing Extruded cut.

script-tab.caption: The Script tab in the left panel with the bracket example in the code box and the Run button, and the resulting plate with two holes and rounded edges in the viewport.

sheet-dxf-options.caption: The Flat pattern DXF dialog: DXF version, units, layers, layer names, bend lines, tangent lines and bend notes.

sheet-edge-flange-editor.caption: The Edge flange editor with four edges picked: Height, Angle, Bend radius, Height measured and Flange position, with the four legs previewed on the plate.

sheet-flat-pattern.caption: The flat pattern panel for the tray: the blank outline and bend zones, the bend lines B1 to B5 with their angles, the blank size and rule, the bend table and the three export buttons.

sheet-rule-editor.caption: The Rules editor on the Sheet metal tab: the Stock section (rule name, thickness, k-factor, bend radius) and the Relief section (relief width and depth, corner relief and its shape, the gaps).

size-box.caption: An extruded block selected from the feature tree with its size box shown: face handles, corner handles, the anchor diamond and the three dimension labels.

sk3d-on-mesh.caption: A spline fitted to the surface of an imported mesh, with the Mesh section of the 3D Sketch panel showing Draw on the imported mesh surface and Fit curves.

sk3d-panel.caption: The 3D Sketch panel at the top: the Draw buttons with Spline chosen and its hint, a header with the help button and close, and Cancel and Create in a bar at the bottom.

sk3d-pipe.caption: A circle swept along the 3D spline to make a pipe, with the Sweep editor open on the left showing Profile and Path.

sk3d-spiral-path.caption: A spline through six points that climb in a loose spiral, with the Points table of the 3D Sketch panel showing each point's X, Y and Z.

sketch-bar.caption: The one-row sketch bar: the Editing tab, the sketch tool groups, and the degrees-of-freedom chip with Fully define, Sketch Report, Snaps and Look normal at the right.

sketch-editor-open.caption: A sketch open on the top face of a plate: the Editing tab of the ribbon, the faded body, the status chip, and the pointer coordinates in the status bar.

sketch-tools-palette.caption: The Draw group of the sketch ribbon with the Rectangle flyout open, listing the tool names and their keys.

split-editor.caption: An 80 x 50 x 30 mm block cut by a plane into two bodies, Base and Lid, with the Split body editor open in the left panel showing the plane, the offset and the names of the two halves.

surfaces-tab.caption: The Surfaces tab of the ribbon with a wavy extruded surface standing on a plate, tinted teal, and the Create and Edit groups visible.

tab-strip.caption: The top bar with three open parts as document tabs, the first marked as changed, the Part / Drawing switch and command search at the right, and the ribbon tabs underneath.

text-panel.caption: The Text tool open in a sketch with the text panel (characters, cap height, font, anchor grid, on an arc) and the lettering RPM x100 laid along an arc.

thicken-variable.caption: The Thicken editor with Variable thickness ticked, Ramp along set to Z axis, and two stops: position 0 at 4 mm and position 10 at 2 mm.

thin-wall.caption: A C-shaped open spline extruded as a thin wall, with the Thin wall section of the Extrude editor open showing Wall thickness, Side and End caps.

tool-rail.caption: The tool rail down the left edge of the view, with the Create section opened on its flyout.

tree-error.caption: The feature tree after the first extrude lost its sketch: the failed row is red and the rows that depend on it are muted and carry blocked-by chips.

variables-panel.caption: The Variables tab for a parametric bracket with four variables (width, depth, thick and hole) and the Configurations list below with Small, Standard and Large.

wizard-insert.caption: The Heat-set insert wizard open in the left panel with an M3 insert previewed: outside diameter, length, hole diameter and depth, groove rings, the Also cut the hole option and the Unverified tag.

wizard-nut.caption: The Nut wizard open in the left panel with an M8 regular (ISO 4032) nut previewed: Type, Size, Chamfer the corners and Thread, the dimensions read from the standard with the Unverified tag, and the first face centre.

wizard-propeller.caption: The Propeller wizard open in the left panel on its Blade step, with the live preview of a three-blade propeller in the viewport.

wizard-screw.caption: The Screw wizard open in the left panel with an M3 pan-head screw previewed on the top plane, showing Size, Length, Head, Drive, Bearing face centre and Shank points.

wizard-spring.caption: The Spring wizard open in the left panel with a compression spring previewed and the Ends setting set to Closed and ground: Closed turns per end, the grinding note and the derived pitch and wire length.

wizard-standoff.caption: The Standoff wizard open in the left panel with an M3 round, female-female standoff previewed: Size, Shape, Ends, Length, Outside diameter and Thread length, with the Unverified tag.

wizard-washer.caption: The Washer wizard open in the left panel with the Standard list filtered to M8 and an M8 flat washer previewed.
